name: GLaDOwOS
check: A con booth animatronic. Has been running tests since 2014. Alone.
survivalEndText: * Test complete. You get no cake.
invulnerableHitText: * Your attack bounces off. It's mostly plastic.

acts.label: Ask About the Cake
acts.text: * You ask when the cake will be ready.
acts.response: The cake is being prepared. For other test subjects.

acts.label: Compliment the Booth
acts.text: * You compliment the booth's impeccable cable management.
acts.response: Flattery has been noted. In your file. Under "suck-up".

acts.label: Hug Barky
acts.text: * You hug Barky for emotional support. You recover 5 HP.
acts.response: I'm not the carry right now. I'm emotional support.

default: * GLaDOwOS recalculates the test's acceptable casualty rate.
* Barky tries not to look at the incinerator.
* The yellow optic follows you without blinking.
Please continue not dying. It improves the sample size.

patterns.speech: Neurotoxin purity: debatable. Musk concentration: regrettable.
The cube cannot feel pain. Barky has filed a disagreement.
Momentum is conserved. Your dignity is not.
